comment: No CWT peak near 4496 A; nearest peaks 4242/4617 A are far off. Targeted fit at 4507.1 A has zero amplitude and no SNR, so not adoptable.
No CWT peak near 4762 A (nearest 4791 A is 30 A off). Targeted fit at 4805.9 A has zero amplitude and absurd 21621 km/s width; not credible.
No CWT peak near 5541 A. Targeted fit at 5503.9 A has zero amplitude and 6203 km/s width; not adoptable.
CWT peak at 8127.2 A (z=1.9026) matches predicted 8127.7 A within 0.5 A; SNR 22.7, ridge 22, FWHM 755 km/s. Red-edge caveat but credible.

Trough at 8120.0 A (z=1.9000) is 7.7 A blueward of predicted; SNR 9.5, ridge 5. Sits in the wing of the strong Mg II emission peak at 8127.2 A, so blend ambiguity; weak but plausible absorption component.
